title: Positive-degree natural Mayer--Vietoris segment with stage-leg squares
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $U,V\subseteq X$ quasi-compact opens [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions].  Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preordered set and let $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ be an inverse diagram of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition morphisms. Let $(T,(f_i))$ be a limit cone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $i$, let $F_i$ be an abelian sheaf on $(D_i)_{\acute{e}t}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], with maps $\varphi_f:D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^{-1}F_i\to F_j$ for $f:i\to j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] satisfying the canonical inverse-image identity and composition laws. Let $G:I\to\operatorname{Ab}(T_{\acute{e}t})$ be identified objectwise with $f_i^{-1}F_i$ by isomorphisms, its arrows being inverse-image composition followed by pullback of $\varphi_f$. Let $L$ be a colimit cocone on $G$, with coprojections $\iota_i$. Fix q≥0 and put p=q+1. Let $H:I\to\operatorname{Ab}$ have specified object isomorphisms $e_i:H_i\cong H^p(D_i,F_i)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] and arrows conjugate to $H^p(\varphi_f)\circ D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^*$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Let $B$ be a cocone on $H$ with an isomorphism $e:B_{\mathrm{pt}}\cong H^p(T,L_{\mathrm{pt}})$ such that, for every $i$, its leg $b_i$ satisfies $e\circ b_i=H^p(\iota_i)\circ f_i^*\circ e_i$, including the specified identification $G_i\cong f_i^{-1}F_i$. Fix an index $i_0\in I$ and an isomorphism $\epsilon:D_{i_0}\cong (U\cup V)$. Put $g=f_{i_0}$ followed by $\epsilon$ and the inclusion $U\cup V\to X$, and let $W_U=g^{-1}(U)$ and $W_V=g^{-1}(V)$. Put $Q=\varinjlim_I H_i$, with its canonical comparison $m:Q\to B_{\mathrm{pt}}$ induced by the cocone $B$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Put $B_4=H^p(W_U,L|_{W_U})\times H^p(W_V,L|_{W_V})$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and let $r':B_{\mathrm{pt}}\to B_4$ be the pair of canonical restriction maps after $e:B_{\mathrm{pt}}\cong H^p(T,L_{\mathrm{pt}})$.  There are a nonempty directed preorder J, a final functor t:J→I, functors K1,K2,K4:J→Ab, maps a:K1→K2, b:K2→t⋙H, r:t⋙H→K4, cocones C1,C2, maps a′:C1.pt→C2.pt, b′:C2.pt→B.pt and v4:colim K4→B4. Both stage pairs (a_j,b_j), (b_j,r_j) and the bottom pair (a′,b′) are exact. The desc maps of C1,C2 and v4 have [def-weil-pbc-stage-cohomology-comparison] certificates for U,V,U∩V. For every j the stage-leg squares commute: a_j C2_j=C1_j a′, b_j B_{t(j)}=C2_j b′, and r_j ι_j v4=B_{t(j)} r′. Neither the cofinality isomorphism nor the three whole-colimit squares are asserted.

proof.text: Construct the degree-indexed canonical restricted diagrams and cocones on the opens U,V and their intersection. No colimithood is asserted.

Prove finality of the directed tail. Transfer quasi-separatedness along e to the union stage, so compact U and V have compact intersection without assuming X quasi-separated. Apply the arbitrary-degree open comparison certificate separately to the five factors.

Apply the compatible Mayer Vietoris maps theorem to those concrete diagrams. Colim is additive and preserves biproducts; its mapBiprod isomorphism followed by biprodIsoProd identifies each product comparison with the product of factor comparisons. Prove that identification on every colimit leg using the projection formulas. Use the iso, prod and comp certificate constructors. The last square reduces to its supplied stage-leg square by colimit.ι_desc.
